title: Hay --- There Is, There Are, Same Word
label: ch:hay
canDo: I can say there is and there are with one form that never changes.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C54-hay: produce hay una casa and hay libros, and say what hay agrees with.
payoff.note: The one common Spanish verb form that counts nothing at all -- visible as a gift only now, after 167 chapters of agreement.
